read.title: Brainstorming Session for the Spring Campaign
read.text:
To: Marketing Team
From: Hana Park

We will hold a brainstorming session next Tuesday at 2 p.m. in Meeting Room B. The goal is to come up with ideas for our spring campaign for the new toner line.

Please come with at least two ideas. They don't have to be perfect. In the first half hour, we will simply share ideas without judging them. After that, we will build on the strongest ones and discuss whether they are feasible within our budget and timeline.

By the end of the session, we hope to narrow down the list to three ideas. I will share a short summary with everyone the next day.

Thank you,
Hana

write.task: 팀 회의에서 연말 고객 감사 이벤트 아이디어를 내야 해요. 아이디어 하나를 제안하고, 다른 사람 의견에 덧붙이는 짧은 발언을 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a short comment for a team meeting that suggests one idea for a year-end customer event and builds on a colleague's idea.
hints: Just to throw it out there
write.model: Just to throw it out there, what if we sent a handwritten card with every order in December? It's simple and feasible with our current budget. I'd also like to build on Jisoo's idea about a gift set. We could put the card inside the set and add a small discount code for next year.
